extract.name: Meridian Markets — 90-day extract
extract.description: A 10-store pilot slice of Meridian Markets.

columns.name: item_id
columns.notes: Primary key. Joins to both fact files.

columns.name: description
columns.notes: Item name as merchandising refers to it.

columns.name: dept
columns.notes: Produce, Dairy, Meat, Bakery, Deli, Grocery.

columns.name: unit_of_measure
columns.notes: LB or EA. The unit that units_sold is counted in.

columns.name: case_size
columns.notes: Units per case. Correct for every item — use it to convert shipment cases to units.

columns.name: unit_cost
columns.notes: Meridian's cost per unit, in dollars. Stable over the window.

columns.name: date
columns.notes: Date the shipment arrived at the store.

columns.name: cases_received
columns.notes: Cases, not units. Units received = cases_received * case_size.

files.grain: one row per store-item-day with movement
files.notes: Store-item-days with no movement are absent rather than zero-filled.
